title: Oromo Qocho with Lamb
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Southern Oromo Qocho with Lamb — enset-based Kocho bread served with a mildly spiced Oromo-style lamb stew. The southern Oromo communities that border the Wolayta and Gurage regions have adopted enset as a staple alongside their traditional dairy foods.
longDesc: Southern Oromo Qocho represents the cultural meeting point between Oromo cattle culture and the enset-eating traditions of the southern Ethiopian peoples.
steps: Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, ginger, berbere, turmeric.
Add lamb. Brown 5 minutes. Add tomatoes. Add ½ cup water.
chefTips: Oromo version uses less berbere than Amhara.
cookingScience: See ETH021 for lamb stew science.
culturalNote: Southern Oromo Qocho with lamb represents the cultural mixing zone of southern Ethiopia — where the cattle-herding Oromo tradition meets the enset-farming southern highland cultures.
